articles.title: Uttar Pradesh Assembly strength is set to jump from 403 seats to 650
articles.summary: The legislative assembly strength in Uttar Pradesh is planned to increase from 403 seats to 650 seats according to a recent report by The Avenue Mail published in Jamshedpur. This expansion aims to alter the political representation within the region. Further details regarding the exact implementation timeline and legislative process for this significant capacity expansion have not been finalized yet.

articles.title: PM Modi Inaugurates AI Centre At IIT Patna, Initiates Rs 400 Crore Research Park
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 21 virtually inaugurated the Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence (AI) at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Patna. He also laid the foundation stones for the IIT Patna Research Park and a 120-bed hostel for startup incubatees. The projects aim to strengthen research, innovation and entrepreneurship in Bihar.

articles.title: ‘Last local militant’: India declares victory but Kashmir’s rebels adapt
articles.summary: Analysts say that shifting tactics, names and geography challenge claims of win against Kashmir’s separatist movement. Kulgam and Srinagar, Indian-administered Kashmir – After a seven-day search, Indian security forces trapped Mohammad Lateef Bhat in a mosque in Zangalpora village, in Indian-administered Kashmir’s Kulgam district. A gunfight broke out and Bhat was killed on November 18.

articles.title: Political controversy in Bihar as Nitish Setu inauguration sparks dispute over credit
articles.summary: A political dispute has emerged in Bihar following Prime Minister Narendra Modi's inauguration of the Nitish Setu over the Ganga. Prashant Kishor, leader of Jan Suraaj, criticised the Bharatiya Janata Party, accusing it of overshadowing the Janata Dal United. Kishor highlighted Nitish Kumar's absence from the inauguration and government publicity despite being in Patna to welcome the Prime Minister.

articles.title: Twenty-two police personnel in Lucknow face investigation for various crimes
articles.summary: Twenty-two police personnel in Lucknow are facing allegations in eleven criminal cases recorded since two thousand thirteen. The officers are under investigation for serious offenses including robbery, extortion, bribery, murder, and drug trafficking. Authorities are currently reviewing these cases to determine appropriate disciplinary and legal actions against the accused staff members.

articles.title: CM Samrat Choudhary To Inaugurate Sonepur Mela Today
articles.summary: The district administration has made security arrangements at the temple and surrounding areas ahead of his visit. Officials and police personnel have been directed to coordinate arrangements for the inauguration venue, entry and exit routes, barricading, traffic management, parking and security. Special security measures have been put in place at the temple premises and nearby areas.

articles.title: Bhopal gas disaster court seeks Central Bureau of Investigation reply on retrial plea
articles.summary: On Friday, lawyers for two convicts in the Bhopal gas disaster case filed applications before the principal district judge in Bhopal. The convicts, S P Chaudhary and J Mukund, asked the judge to reconsider an order regarding a criminal appeal. The court sought a reply from the Central Bureau of Investigation on this fresh retrial plea.

articles.title: AAP minister slams Bihar govt over naming bridge after Nitish Kumar
articles.summary: Senior Aam Aadmi Party leader and Punjab Cabinet Minister Harpal Singh Cheema has condemned the Bihar government's decision to name the six-lane Dargah-Bidupur cable bridge 'Nitish Setu', news agency Press Trust of India reported. Cheema said the assembly had earlier been informed about a proposal to name the bridge after Guru Gobind Singh, the tenth Sikh Guru.

articles.summary_hi: समाचार एजेंसी प्रेस ट्रस्ट ऑफ इंडिया की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, आम आदमी पार्टी के वरिष्ठ नेता और पंजाब के कैबिनेट मंत्री हरपाल सिंह चीमा ने छह लेन वाले दरगाह-बिदुपुर केबल ब्रिज का नाम 'नीतीश सेतु' रखने के बिहार सरकार के फैसले की निंदा की है। चीमा ने कहा कि विधानसभा को पहले ही पुल का नाम दसवें सिख गुरु, गुरु गोबिंद सिंह के नाम पर रखने के प्रस्ताव के बारे में सूचित किया गया था।

articles.title: Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar directs police to intensify crackdown on illegal arms
articles.summary: On Friday, Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar instructed police officers to enhance intelligence gathering and prioritize crime prevention. This directive followed criticism from her nephew, Member of Legislative Assembly Rohit Pawar, who questioned her capability to manage responsibilities as the Pune guardian minister. The police are now expected to increase their enforcement efforts across the region.

articles.title: BJP OBC Morcha Announces New National Office Bearers and Committees
articles.summary: The seven newly appointed national vice presidents of the BJP OBC Morcha are Jogen Mohan (Assam), Mamata Mohanta (Odisha), Sangam Lal Gupta (Uttar Pradesh), Babanrao Ravji Choudhary (Maharashtra), Sat Prakash Rana (Delhi), Arjun Sahani (Bihar), and Sangeeta Balwant Bind (Uttar Pradesh). Gajendra Yadav (Delhi), Pramod Madhwaraj (Karnataka), and Lalit Chandrakar (Chhattisgarh) have been named as national general secretaries.

articles.title: RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav suspects Parliament special sitting called with eye on assembly
articles.summary: Tejashwi Yadav has raised concerns about the upcoming special sitting of Parliament being politically motivated. He believes it may be organized to influence upcoming assembly elections in various states. Yadav reiterated his party's longstanding position on the delimitation bill and criticized the government's lack of inclusivity. Union minister Giriraj Singh responded sharply, challenging Yadav's claims about political intentions.

articles.title: Nagaland: ABAM seeks probe into Rs 249.21-lakh Impur heritage project

articles.title: Nishant thanks PM, CM for naming 6-lane bridge after his father
articles.summary: Naming the Kachhi Dargah-Bidupur six-lane bridge after Nitish Kumar recognises his two decades of efforts towards Bihar’s development, health minister Nishant Kumar, the son of the former CM, said on Saturday. articles.title: Prime Minister Modi inaugurates Nitish Setu bridge and praises Bihar's development
articles.summary: He praised the state's progress and inaugurated the Dargah-Bidupur six-lane cable bridge, named Nitish Setu after Nitish Kumar.
